stories.title: The Swifties Close 2025 With Speer's Third Crown
stories.body: Thomas Speer's The Swifties completed an 11–3 season by defeating Collin Krum 129.64–107.88 in the championship. The 21.76-point win delivered Speer's third league title after his back-to-back championships in 2020 and 2021.

stories.title: Hall Goes Back-to-Back With The Diddlers
stories.body: Jared Hall followed his 2023 title with another championship in 2024. The Diddlers finished 11–3 and beat George Travis 161.22–135.48, making Hall the league's second repeat champion and a three-time winner.

stories.title: Crown The King Survives the Closest Final
stories.body: Jared Hall's Crown The King finished 9–5 and edged JD Daley 126.12–121.20 in the 2023 championship. The 4.92-point margin remains the closest title game in the checked-in playoff archive.

stories.title: Travis Breaks Through From the No. 3 Seed
stories.body: George Travis turned an 8–6 regular season into the 2022 championship. His No. 3 seed defeated JD Daley 134.28–81.30 in the final, a 52.98-point victory.

stories.title: Speer Completes the League's First Repeat
stories.body: Thomas Speer made league history in 2021 by winning a second straight championship. After a 9–5 regular season, Has a Nice Ring to it defeated Kyle Fowler 130.60–109.16 in the title game.

stories.title: Speer Wins the 2020 Title in a Rout
stories.body: Thomas Speer's Has a Nice Ring to it entered the playoffs as the No. 2 seed after a 7–6 season. Speer defeated German Haro 165.30–107.16 in the championship, winning by 58.14 points.

stories.title: Daley Takes the Long Road to the 2019 Crown
stories.body: JD Daley won the 2019 championship from the No. 4 seed after an 8–5 regular season. We're on to Cleveland defeated Trevor Hash 136.06–123.10 in the final, a 12.96-point decision.

stories.title: Fowler Captures the League's Second Championship
stories.body: Kyle Fowler's Turn Goff the Lights finished 9–4 and entered the 2018 playoffs as the No. 1 seed. Fowler defeated George Travis 145.64–125.52 in the championship by 20.12 points.

stories.title: Hall Claims the Inaugural 1048 Gate Crown
stories.body: Jared Hall set the first championship standard in 2017. Flash In The Flex finished 10–3, earned the No. 1 seed, and defeated George Travis 155.60–123.82 in the league's inaugural final.
